t: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
d: Tally up the unsettling occurrences in reality star Chloe Ferry's isolated mansion, where things go missing and windows mysteriously shatter in the dead of night. Encounter a terrifying shadow man and learn of the home's link to the Geordie Ripper.

t: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
d: Get chills at opera singer Russell Watson's idyllic farm, where an invisible visitor plays the piano and scares anyone who happens by. Track down a cannibal killer with the team, who have to act fast to send this evil spirit back to the dark side.
Watch a boy encounter a terrifying being, and an imaginary friend turns evil.
Witness a poltergeist become aggressive while a ghost makes a deadly return.
Find out if a creature with the face of a serpent and neck of a swan is real.
Hunt for the legendary Jersey Devil and see if fact is stranger than fiction.
Travel to a Pennsylvania county haunted by the Thunderbird, UFOs, and Bigfoot.
